metadata.question: Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and  2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices (MOD13Q1) for consistent NDVI across 2003–2011 and 2016–2017. Filter to June via calendarRange. Region: an explicit polygon approximating Asir (inland to avoid Red Sea).
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds/snow using SummaryQA < 2 and apply NDVI scale factor 0.0001. Compute valid pixel counts to detect C2.
3. Logic: If any collection size is 0 after initial/fallback → C1. If valid pixel count is 0 after masking → C2. If mean NDVI is null/NaN/outside [-0.2,1.1] → C3. Otherwise compare 2016 and 2017 means vs long-term June mean (2003–2011). If both greater → A, else → B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    // Approximate Asir ROI (avoid Red Sea coastline by shifting west edge inland)
    const asirROI = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
      [42.2, 17.5],
      [44.0, 17.5],
      [44.0, 20.8],
      [42.2, 20.8],
      [42.2, 17.5]
    ]]);

    const scale = 1000; // meters
    const maxPixels = 2e9;

    // Helper: async getInfo wrapper
    const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    // Helper: Prepare NDVI (scale + QA mask)
    function prepNDVI(img) {
      const qaMask = img.select('SummaryQA').lt(2); // 0=good,1=marginal keep; 2 snow/ice, 3 cloud -> mask out
      const ndvi = img.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001).updateMask(qaMask).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }

    // Build collection with fallback if needed
    async function getJuneCollection(yearStart, yearEnd) {
      let id = 'MODIS/061/MOD13Q1';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(id)
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(yearStart, yearEnd, 'year'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month'))
        .filterBounds(asirROI);
      let sz = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (sz === 0) {
        id = 'MODIS/006/MOD13Q1';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(id)
          .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(yearStart, yearEnd, 'year'))
          .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month'))
          .filterBounds(asirROI);
        sz = await getInfo(col.size());
      }
      return { id, col, sz };
    }

    // Stats for a given year range (June only)
    async function computeJuneStats(yearStart, yearEnd, label) {
      const { id, col, sz } = await getJuneCollection(yearStart, yearEnd);
      if (sz === 0) {
        console.log(`${label} June images: 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return { stop: true };
      }
      const ndviCol = col.map(prepNDVI).select('NDVI');
      const comp = ndviCol.mean();
      // Total pixels at analysis scale (independent of mask)
      const total = await getInfo(
        ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: asirROI,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('ones')
      );
      const count = await getInfo(
        comp.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: asirROI,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('NDVI')
      );
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        console.log(`${label} June images: ${sz}, valid: 0/${total} (0.0%)`);
        console.log('C2');
        return { stop: true };
      }
      const mean = await getInfo(
        comp.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: asirROI,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('NDVI')
      );
      const validFrac = total ? (count / total) : 0;
      if (mean === null || !isFinite(mean) || mean < -0.2 || mean > 1.1) {
        console.log(`${label} June images: ${sz}, NDVI: ${mean}, valid: ${count}/${total} (${(validFrac * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);
        console.log('C3');
        return { stop: true };
      }
      console.log(`${label} June images: ${sz}, mean NDVI: ${mean.toFixed(3)}, valid: ${count}/${total} (${(validFrac * 100).toFixed(1)}%) [${id}]`);
      return { stop: false, mean, count, total, sz, id };
    }

    // 2. Compute stats
    const y2016 = await computeJuneStats(2016, 2016, '2016');
    if (y2016.stop) return;
    const y2017 = await computeJuneStats(2017, 2017, '2017');
    if (y2017.stop) return;
    const lt = await computeJuneStats(2003, 2011, 'LT 2003–2011');
    if (lt.stop) return;

    // 3. Comparison & Final Answer
    const gt2016 = y2016.mean > lt.mean;
    const gt2017 = y2017.mean > lt.mean;
    console.log(`Comparisons: 2016>LT=${gt2016}, 2017>LT=${gt2017}`);

    if (gt2016 && gt2017) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Unexpected errors (dataset/band/memory/issues)
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
